sync.title: Digital Transformation from Government to Industry
sync.rawTitle: #15 - Gina Tost: Digital Transformation from Government to Industry | Leading in AI Podcast
sync.youtubeDescription:
Gina Tost works at a global dermatology company, where her role spans content, global PR, social media, events, partnerships, innovation and AI. She is one of Spain’s best-known technology journalists and was the voice behind Generació Digital on Catalunya Ràdio for more than a decade. She co-founded the startup Geenapp, led European and Latin American operations for the mobile game company IGG, and from 2022 to 2024 was Secretary of Digital Policies of the Generalitat de Catalunya.

In this episode, Gina shares what digital transformation looks like from inside government and industry: why it starts with people’s problems and not with technology, what it took to update Catalonia’s AI strategy and start its quantum strategy, why AI in dermatology has to put science first, and how AI could change our relationship with knowledge.

Topics covered:
- From design to tech journalism, startups, gaming and government
- Different chapters of the same book: understanding technology and society
- Shaping the digital agenda for 8 million citizens
- Why digital transformation must be inclusive: economic, geographic, cultural, linguistic, educational and gender divides
- Don’t digitalize the problem: start with what citizens actually need
- How AI can make government more proactive, accessible and efficient, and why it should open the black boxes
- Updating Catalonia’s AI strategy and starting work on its quantum strategy
- Building strategy by listening to the experts
- Her current role: connecting science, creativity, technology and brand
- Science first: the problem with AI-generated before-and-after images
- Using AI to adapt content, translation and regulation to each market
- Where AI will surprise us: our relationship with knowledge and expertise
- Advice for early-career professionals: understand the world beyond technology
